datum: Cell mast handovers logged as the handset moves between masts
mechanism: Network signalling generated automatically to route calls and data, kept as call- and session-detail records
conditions: Applies to any switched-on handset registered to a network
Retention length is set by national law where a retention notice is in force

sources.title: Investigatory Powers Act 2016, Section 87: Data retention notices

datum: Wifi and Bluetooth probe requests broadcast to nearby receivers
mechanism: Handsets periodically broadcast probe requests carrying a MAC address, which street furniture or venue sensors log as footfall
conditions: Applies where a venue, street furniture or vehicle operates wifi/Bluetooth sensors
Modern handsets randomise the MAC address by default, which reduces but does not eliminate linkability across sightings

sources.title: London Puts Stop To Sidewalk Bins That Track Cellphones

datum: Which apps are opened, in what order, and for how long
mechanism: Usage logging built into the operating system, surfaced to the person through a screen-time dashboard
conditions: Built into the handset operating system
Whether a copy leaves the device depends on the person's diagnostics and analytics settings

sources.title: Get started with Screen Time on iPhone
Manage how you spend time on your Android phone with Digital Wellbeing

datum: Home and work locations, inferred from where the handset dwells overnight and by day
mechanism: Location pings clustered by dwell time and time of day; never entered by the person
conditions: Requires some source of location signal reaching a broker: an app SDK, wifi lookup, or cell data

datum: Card tap at boarding or barrier, with time and stop
mechanism: The fare system logs each tap to calculate the fare and detect incomplete journeys
conditions: Applies to smartcard and contactless fare systems
TfL journey data is de-personalised roughly eight weeks after the trip; payment card details tied to an account can be held up to 18 months

sources.title: Oyster card — how we use your personal information

datum: Onboard and platform CCTV
mechanism: Continuous recording, retained on a fixed schedule and disclosed to police on request
conditions: Applies where the operator runs onboard or platform cameras

datum: Commuting pattern and likely shift hours
mechanism: Derived from the regularity of tap times and routes across weeks

datum: Household income band, correlated from route and stop
mechanism: Stop and postcode-level correlation used as a proxy for income

datum: Other passengers captured in the same CCTV frames
mechanism: A fixed camera records everyone in frame, not only the account holder

datum: Placement in a commuter advertising segment built from strangers' data
mechanism: Segments are trained on aggregate behaviour across many riders, then applied back to an individual

datum: Merchant, amount, time, and terminal ID
mechanism: Logged by the card network and issuing bank to authorise and settle the payment

datum: Item-level SKUs on the receipt, linked to an identity if a loyalty card is scanned
mechanism: Point-of-sale system itemises the basket; loyalty accounts attach it to a customer record
conditions: Requires a loyalty card or linked payment method to attach to an identity

datum: Store entry and dwell time on camera
mechanism: In-store cameras and, increasingly, shelf sensors log presence and movement

datum: Spending category profile and an estimate of disposable income
mechanism: Built from the pattern of merchant categories over time

datum: Life-stage flags — a new baby, a house move, an illness — inferred from a shift in basket composition
mechanism: A shift in the mix of items bought is scored against known patterns for the life event
conditions: The best-documented case involves one named US retailer's pregnancy-prediction program; the underlying technique is understood to generalise

datum: Anyone shopped for appears in the profile as the account holder's own habit
mechanism: The basket is attributed entirely to the account holder regardless of who the items are for

datum: Smoker or drinker status attached to the record from a purchase category alone
mechanism: Purchase category is treated as sufficient signal; no declaration is needed

datum: Health-risk score used to help set a quoted insurance premium
mechanism: Combines the purchase-derived status with other signals into an underwriting score

datum: Ad segments built for cessation products and for the habit itself, from the same signal
mechanism: A single behavioural signal feeds two commercially opposed segments

datum: Other household members scored on the same shared-address purchase basket
mechanism: Address-level linkage spreads one person's purchases across everyone registered at the address

datum: Timestamps of every app session, including ones after midnight
mechanism: Recorded by the operating system's screen-time feature for every foreground session
conditions: Built into the handset operating system

sources.title: Get started with Screen Time on iPhone

datum: Scroll velocity, pauses, and rewatched content
mechanism: Client-side interaction telemetry sent back to the platform to tune what is shown next

datum: Text typed into a post box and then deleted before sending
mechanism: Client-side code observes keystrokes in the composer; a large study of one platform found this is captured and analysed even when nothing is posted
conditions: Documented for one major platform studied in 2013; described as a general client-side technique, not confirmed for every platform

sources.title: Self-Censorship on Facebook
sources.publisher: Proceedings of the International AAAI Conference on Web and Social Media (ICWSM 2013)

datum: Screen-on time and sleep window, from handset or wearable sensors
mechanism: Accelerometer, screen state, and charging events combine into a sleep-window estimate

sources.title: Manage how you spend time on your Android phone with Digital Wellbeing

datum: Disrupted sleep and mood state, inferred from posting hours
mechanism: Night-time engagement is treated as a proxy signal for distress or insomnia

datum: Emotional-volatility score used to time what content is shown
mechanism: Engagement patterns across sessions are scored for volatility and fed back into ranking

datum: Feed content ranked using what similar late-night users stayed on
mechanism: Ranking models trained on the aggregate behaviour of a cohort are applied to the individual

datum: GPS trace of the route, with pace per segment
mechanism: Recorded continuously during a tracked activity and uploaded to the app's servers

datum: Heart rate, cadence, and recovery time
mechanism: Sampled continuously by the wearable's sensors during and after activity

datum: Faces captured in doorbell and dashcam footage along the route
mechanism: Privately owned cameras along public routes record anyone passing

datum: Fitness trajectory and injury risk
mechanism: Trends across sessions are scored against population models

datum: Home address, inferred from where routes begin and end
mechanism: Loop-shaped routes reveal an origin point even when a privacy radius is applied near it
conditions: A public aggregate heatmap of activity data has been shown to reveal the layout and use patterns of otherwise undisclosed sites

sources.title: Strava has published details about secret military bases, and an Australian was the first to know

datum: Everyone passed on the route, recorded incidentally by others' cameras
mechanism: Fixed and dashboard cameras record whoever crosses their field of view

datum: Personal times made legible only by ranking against a public segment leaderboard
mechanism: A route segment's leaderboard is built from every other user who has run it

datum: Call detail record: numbers, duration, time, and serving mast
mechanism: Generated to bill and route the call; content is not needed, the metadata is the product
conditions: Retention length is set by national law where a retention notice is in force

sources.title: Investigatory Powers Act 2016, Section 87: Data retention notices

datum: Contact graph and typical reply latency
mechanism: Built from message metadata across the account's history

datum: Closeness ranking of relationships, from frequency, duration, and who calls first
mechanism: A ranking model scores relationship strength from interaction patterns

datum: Caregiving burden, bereavement, or family crisis, inferred from a sharp change in call pattern
mechanism: A sudden change in call frequency or timing is treated as a legible life-event signal

datum: A phone number entered into the graph by someone else's contact sync, without the number's owner ever joining
mechanism: Contact-upload features add a number to the platform's graph even for people who hold no account

datum: Number plate reads at fixed and mobile cameras
mechanism: Cameras automatically read and log plates; forces submit a subset to a national database
conditions: Data submitted to the National ANPR Service is generally retained for 12 months
Where data has evidential or investigative value it may be retained for longer

datum: Telematics: speed, braking, cornering, and night driving
mechanism: A telematics device or the vehicle's own systems log driving events continuously
conditions: Applies to telematics ('black box') insurance policies and many connected vehicles

datum: In-cabin microphone and camera activity
mechanism: Increasingly fitted for driver-monitoring and voice-assistant features
conditions: Applies to vehicles fitted with driver-monitoring or in-cabin voice systems

datum: Driver risk score used to set an insurance premium
mechanism: Telematics events are combined into a scored driving profile

datum: Passengers recorded by the cabin camera or microphone
mechanism: An in-cabin sensor captures everyone in the vehicle, not only the registered driver

datum: Badge swipes and movement between zones
mechanism: Access-control system logs each swipe by location and time

datum: Keystroke rate, idle time, and periodic screenshots
mechanism: Monitoring software installed on the work device samples activity and periodically captures the screen
conditions: Applies where the employer has deployed this class of monitoring software

datum: Meeting transcripts with speaking time per person
mechanism: Meeting software transcribes audio automatically when the feature is enabled
conditions: Applies where meeting transcription is turned on for the organisation or the call

sources.title: Overview — Recording and transcription for Teams meetings, events, and calls

datum: Productivity and flight-risk scores
mechanism: Behavioural and activity signals are combined into a retention-risk model

datum: Colleagues transcribed or logged alongside the account holder
mechanism: A shared meeting or workspace record necessarily includes everyone present

datum: Query text, with timestamp and approximate location
mechanism: Logged to serve and rank results, and to a varying extent kept for the account

datum: Bid requests broadcasting the page, approximate location, and inferred interests to advertising bidders
mechanism: Real-time-bidding auctions broadcast a profile of the visitor to every registered bidder before an ad loads
conditions: Applies to pages and apps carrying real-time-bidding advertising

sources.title: The Biggest Data Breach: ICCL report on the scale of Real-Time Bidding data broadcasts in the U.S. and Europe

datum: Health conditions and worries, inferred from symptom searches
mechanism: Search terms are matched against known symptom and condition vocabularies

datum: Sexuality, faith, or immigration status, inferred and sold on
mechanism: Browsing and app signals are matched against marketing categories covering sensitive attributes

datum: Appliance-level electricity draw, disaggregated from the whole-house signal
mechanism: Non-intrusive load monitoring identifies individual appliances from their electrical signature in the aggregate meter reading
conditions: Applies where the meter records at a resolution fine enough for the technique, and the supplier or a third party applies it

datum: What is on screen, including from devices plugged into the television
mechanism: Automatic content recognition samples the screen continuously and matches it against a reference database
conditions: A US manufacturer was found to have run this without adequate consent from 2014; the practice is now disclosed and typically opt-out

sources.title: VIZIO to Pay $2.2 Million to FTC, State of New Jersey to Settle Charges It Collected Viewing Histories on 11 Million Smart Televisions without Users' Consent

datum: Wake-word audio, sometimes reviewed by a human annotator
mechanism: Clips captured after the wake word are sent for processing and, in a disclosed program, for human review to improve the assistant
conditions: Applies to smart-speaker voice assistants; human-review programs and their opt-outs vary by vendor and have changed over time

sources.title: Amazon Workers Are Listening to What You Tell Alexa

datum: Doorbell footage, sometimes shared with police without a warrant
mechanism: The camera owner's footage can be requested by police through the maker's own emergency-request channel
conditions: One major vendor disclosed doing this in 2022 and later discontinued the specific in-app request tool

sources.title: Ring Reveals They Give Videos to Police Without User Consent or a Warrant

datum: Occupancy, routine, and when the house is empty
mechanism: Disaggregated appliance use over time reveals a routine, including absence

datum: Visitors captured by the doorbell or a neighbour's camera
mechanism: A doorbell records whoever approaches the door, not only residents
